cases.name: every skill of the harness passes check-skills.sh (front matter, length, cited paths, "never", bench commands)
a skill citing a missing reference, too long, with a wrong name and nine "never" is refused on each count
cases.cmd:
d={{FIX}}/skills-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$d/bad" && { printf -- '---
name: good
description: "x"
---
'; printf 'See references/process/no-such-file.md and .claude/templates/TEAM.md. never never never never never never never never never
'; seq 1 230 | sed 's/^/line /'; } > "$d/bad/SKILL.md"; bash {{ROOT}}/evals/check-skills.sh "$d"

cases.name: the same bad skill: the name, the length and the "never" count are each a problem
cases.cmd:
d={{FIX}}/skills-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$d/bad" && { printf -- '---
name: good
description: "x"
---
'; printf 'never never never never never never never never never
'; seq 1 230 | sed 's/^/line /'; } > "$d/bad/SKILL.md"; bash {{ROOT}}/evals/check-skills.sh "$d" | grep -c '^FAIL bad'
